description: Mark one of the signed-in user's Trailersite adverts as sold, with the price it sold for and the day, if the user said. Buyers then see the trailer or caravan as sold. Needs the user to connect their Trailersite account.

salePriceGbp.description: What it sold for. Leave out if the user did not say.

soldOn.description: The day it sold, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today.
